root_cause.text: ep_free() directly frees the eventpoll structure via kfree while a concurrent RCU reader (ep_get_upwards_depth_proc()) may still be accessing it through epi->ep, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an rcu_head to struct eventpoll and replaces kfree(ep) with kfree_rcu(ep, rcu), accompanied by the comment "ep_get_upwards_depth_proc() may still hold epi->ep under RCU".

intent_record.intent_summary: Add RCU head to eventpoll structure to defer freeing past RCU-protected access, preventing use-after-free bugs.
intent_record.what: Added a new member `struct rcu_head rcu;` to the `struct eventpoll` structure along with a comment indicating its purpose.
intent_record.how: This change enables the eventpoll structure to be safely freed via RCU by providing a linkage for deferred deallocation, ensuring that memory is not reclaimed while RCU readers (e.g., in ep_get_upwards_depth_proc()) are still accessing it.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use RCU-safe freeing to avoid use-after-free when RCU readers may still reference the ep structure.
intent_record.what: Replaced kfree(ep) with kfree_rcu(ep, rcu) in ep_free() and added a comment explaining that ep_get_upwards_depth_proc() may still hold epi->ep under RCU.
intent_record.how: This change ensures the ep structure is not freed until after an RCU grace period, preventing a use-after-free race condition if an RCU reader accesses ep through epi->ep after ep_free() has freed it.
